function: Channel estimation of the wavenumber-domain uplink channel h_k at the BS from pilot signals with a CNN-Mamba network (CMamba), plus masked pre-training for few-shot estimation (p. 1, 3-4).
system: Uplink holographic MIMO: BS with 17x65 UPA (N=1105, spacing lambda/4, Nf=300 feeds), K single-antenna UEs (K not given), 7 GHz; no RIS (p. 2, 4).
method: Supervised CMamba (three CNN blocks, Mamba block, MLP-Mixer); masked-signal pre-training on 20,000 unlabeled samples, then fine-tuning the decoder with frozen encoder (p. 4-5).
data_channel: Custom simulator: wavenumber-domain Fourier plane-wave channel with Nc=4 von Mises-Fisher clusters, beta=1.4; 20,000 unlabeled pre-training samples, 3000 labeled training and 3000 labeled testing samples (p. 2, 4-5).
test_conditions: Same simulated scenario for training and testing (3000 test samples); sweeps over SNR 0-30 dB, masking ratio, hardware-distortion kappa; kappa during training not stated (p. 5-6).
baselines: Non-learned: OMP-AD and OMP-WND; learned: ResCNN [6], Transformer [7], U-MLP [8]; also CMamba trained with full samples (p. 5).
metrics: NMSE (dB) versus SNR, number of labeled samples, masking ratio and hardware distortion; average NMSE; parameters (M) and FLOPs (M) in Table I (p. 4-6).
complexity: Table I: CMamba 0.921 M parameters and 343.84 M FLOPs versus ResCNN 0.933 M/477.85 M, U-MLP 2.25 M/526.43 M, Transformer 1.68 M/627.37 M (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "the Fourier plane wave series expansion in the wavenumber domain channel model" of refs [11], [14], with von Mises-Fisher clusters; a custom academic model, no 3GPP TR 38.901, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 5: "there are 3000 labeled samples for training and 3000 labeled samples for testing" in one simulated scenario. p. 2 claims robustness "verified under different degrees of the hardware impairments" (Fig. 8, p. 6), a distortion-level sweep like SNR; the paper never says the model was trained at another kappa.
q3_support: p. 5: "conventional methods, i.e., OMP-AD" and OMP-WND are non-learned; p. 5: "DL-based methods, i.e., ResCNN [6]" with Transformer [7] and U-MLP [8] are earlier learned estimators; compared on NMSE in Figs. 5-6.
q4_support: p. 5: "Table I summarizes the number of parameters and Floating Point Operations (FLOPs) of different networks"; Table I lists 0.921 M parameters and 343.84 M FLOPs for CMamba.
q5_support: p. 5: "we allocate 20,000 unlabeled received signal samples for the pre-training task" from the authors' own simulation; the paper gives no code or data link or DOI and uses no public or measured dataset.
notes: Included, area 2 (channel estimation in holographic MIMO, a continuous-aperture array at the BS and not a RIS, so ris is 0). q1 is 0 because the wavenumber-domain model of [11], [14] is an academic model, not a 3GPP, COST 2100 or DeepMIMO model; reviewer may confirm. q2 is 0 because pre-training, fine-tuning and testing use one simulated scenario and the kappa sweep is a distortion-level sweep.
